task: Issue #3602: reject a frontmatter description that is null, blank, non-string, or written twice, and name the file in the reason.

events.content: Reproduced the defect with the real implementation. Five fixture files under /tmp/p3602: null, blank string, list, duplicate key, and a valid control. All five returned is_agent_definition True, so four shapes every host rejects were counted as shipping agents.

Measured the real corpus before choosing the narrowing. 181 agents across the six AGENT_TREES; zero would be newly rejected. Confirms the issue's latent classification and proves the tightening breaks nothing that ships.

Added DuplicateFrontmatterKey, a YAMLError subclass carrying both block-relative line numbers. Subclassing keeps every existing parse-failure handler correct: a caller that treats a YAMLError as not-an-agent still does.

Added FrontmatterLoader.construct_mapping, which scans composed key nodes for a repeated description before delegating. It runs before super() because the base implementation calls flatten_mapping first, which rewrites node.value when a merge key is present.

Scoped duplicate detection to the description key alone. Only that key decides agent-hood, so only its duplication makes the validator disagree with the host. Firing on any repeated key would also fire on sibling documents that are not agents, turning a targeted signal into noise.

Required description to be a non-empty string. Split reason reporting from path display: is_agent_definition collects reasons, known_agents prefixes the file. Both new parameters are optional, so the 15 existing known_agents call sites keep their shape.

Routed the reasons into ScanResult.config_errors, the channel the CLI already exits 2 on and the one an unreadable markdown file uses. Without it a malformed definition drops out silently and the only symptom is a matrix row naming an agent nobody ships, which points at the citation rather than the broken file.
Wrote 30 tests in tests/build_scripts/test_validate_agent_matrix_refs.py, class TestDescriptionMustBeUsable, including a permanent pin that the real repository ships no unusable description.

Ran an adversarial battery of 34 cases against the real implementation: 19 unusable-value shapes, 8 duplicate spellings including quoted keys, flow mappings, and explicit keys, and 7 valid controls. Zero unexpected results. Promoted the seven strongest evasion classes into permanent tests.

Negative control A: reverted the implementation entirely, all 23 tests then failing. Negative control B isolated each half: removing the non-empty-string check fails 14 tests, removing duplicate detection fails 7. Restored, all 30 pass.

Checked the CI wiring rather than assuming it. .github/workflows/validate-generated-agents.yml invokes the validator in two jobs and its dorny/paths-filter covers all six agent trees, so an added agent file reaches the gate. No filter gap here, unlike the one found on issue #3633.
Verified no mirror exists for build/scripts/, so nothing needs syncing and no plugin manifest bump is required.
